title: Sensor Sweep
reference: repeat 6 { forward if on_switch { activate turn_right } else { turn_left } }
hints: Every slide stops on a switch or a red pad. Switches turn you right, red pads turn you left.
After each slide: on a switch? Flip it and turn right. Otherwise turn left.
repeat 6 { forward if on_switch { activate turn_right } else { turn_left } }
